intended_object: An internal step ("Phase (3c)") of a graph canonical-labelling or partition-refinement algorithm. It is the distribution pass of a counting sort that scatters a cell's vertices into buckets by their count. I inferred this from the docstring and the body.
explanation: The definition is a fuel-driven loop over arrays. For each index k < ec it takes v = lab[k] and t = cnt[v], writes v into block at the offset bc[t], and increments bc[t]. This is the scatter phase of a stable counting sort inside a refinement or canonization algorithm. It is an implementation detail of the library's algorithm, not a standard mathematical object, so it cannot be judged for faithfulness against the literature.
